methods.what: Normalisation of a trace-zero 2×2 substitution matrix with determinant condition
Product of two trace-zero matrices times diag(1,−1) expressed via cos/sin of 2bπ
Imaginary part relation from the product
Recursive transformation of parameters under conjugation (reflection-type recursion)
Conjugation of an involutive matrix by another gives a linear combination ΔA − A₁
Parametrisation of trace-zero involution matrix by a,b,c,d
Square of a trace-zero matrix with α²+βγ=1 is identity
